_about: Hand-authored gold set for retrieval + no-answer evaluation. Each question is phrased the way a store operator would actually ask it (not echoing doc headings). 'correct_doc' = the source_url whose page contains the answer, or null for out-of-scope questions the assistant should refuse. Grounded in the real Medusa user-guide corpus. NOTE: no production traffic yet — these are authored by a domain reader as ground truth; next step is to augment with real support questions.
